what_happened: the s7 NC reference cell died at 01:48:43Z and was not noticed until 04:22:09Z; for about 2 h 34 min nothing was running while dlarch believed it was

timeline_utc.event: combo step SUCCEEDED (three output shas recorded)
died immediately after: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable 'cmp_'
dlarch's waiter grepped PARITY|engine rc|DLARCH_CHAIN, printed NOTHING, and dlarch read the empty output as 'still running'
noticed while checking the cell before the next step

data_lost: none -- the combo artifacts were intact; the loss is wall-clock only

cause_1_incomplete_patch.what: dlarch added an ARCHIVE_ABSENT branch (a reference cell at a seed with no archived combo cannot carry a bitwise self-proof) but did not follow who CONSUMES that branch's variables
cause_1_incomplete_patch.detail: the print statement after the branch reads `cmp_`, which is bound only inside the else (archive-present) path, so the archive-absent path reached it unbound
cause_1_incomplete_patch.class: same family as 'a deletion gate must cover every consumer, not one statistic': a branch was changed without tracing its readers
cause_1_incomplete_patch.fix: the print now reads rec['PARITY'].get('files') or {}, which is defined on both paths; the comment in the code records why

cause_2_the_one_that_cost_the_time.what: the waiter grepped for success markers and printed nothing; dlarch read EMPTY as 'still running' and moved on
cause_2_the_one_that_cost_the_time.why_it_is_the_worse_half: the patch bug cost seconds -- it would have been found on the next look. Reading 'empty' as 'in progress' is what cost 2.5 hours, and it is a reading error, not a coding error.
cause_2_the_one_that_cost_the_time.already_written_twice_today: dlarch had recorded, twice on 2026-09-25, that a waiter which can only succeed turns a stall into silence. This time dlarch READ the blank output and still walked away, which is worse than not having looked.
cause_2_the_one_that_cost_the_time.fix: waiters must print an explicit outcome word -- DONE / FAILED / RUNNING / GONE_WITHOUT_MARKER -- computed from a chain of tests, never leaving the reader to infer state from whether a grep matched. Verified in use at 04:24:37Z, which printed STATE=RUNNING.

why_this_is_filed: lead asked for the idle time to be recorded honestly in a receipt. Filed so the cost exists on disk and not only in a message, and so the two causes are separable by a later reader: one was a coding slip, the other was a habit of reading absence as progress.
cross_reference: the same 'absence is not progress' shape appears in the 2026-09-25 waiter that reported 'T0 FAMILY STALLED 0/8' when the truth was 8/8 -- there the instrument lied loudly; here it said nothing at all, which was harder to notice.
